home.noAddonsLead: None of your addons has a catalog. Add one, such as Cinemeta, to fill Home.
home.allHiddenLead: Every Home row is hidden. Show them again in Settings, Home rows.
home.noKidsRowsLead: None of the addons has family films or series yet. A grown-up can add one, such as Cinemeta.
home.sportsOnlyLead: Your addons only list sport, which has its own place in the menu. Add an addon such as Cinemeta for films and series.

search.label: Search
search.placeholder: Search for a film or series
search.hint: Press OK on the box to type. The microphone key on the TV keyboard lets you speak instead.
search.noAddons: None of your addons can search. Add one, such as Cinemeta, in Addons.

sports.title: Sports
sports.nothingLive: Nothing is live right now. Today shows what is on later.
sports.nothingOnDay: Your sports addons list nothing for this day.
sports.more: Your sports addons may list more than BannerTV shows here.
sports.addonGone: The addon that listed this has been removed.
sports.notInLists: Nothing in your sports addons' lists matches. They can be asked directly.

discover.empty: This catalog has nothing to show yet.
discover.noCatalogs: None of your addons has a catalog to browse. Add one, such as Cinemeta, in Addons.

addons.lead: Addons give BannerTV its catalogs and titles, and in Phase 2 its streams. Higher addons answer first, and their rows come first on Home.
addons.none: You have no addons, so Home is empty. Add one, such as Cinemeta, with its address.
addons.removeMessage: Its rows leave Home and it stops answering for titles. You can add it again later from its address.
addons.added: Added {{name}}. Its catalogs are on Home now.
addons.installLead: Type the addon's address: it usually ends in manifest.json. The microphone key on the TV keyboard lets you say it instead.

phone.title: Or send it from your phone
phone.scan: Scan with your phone's camera, or go to this address and enter the code:
phone.unavailable: BannerTV can't reach its pairing service right now.
phone.received: Received from your phone. Press Add to add it.
phone.dropped: Another address came from your phone while BannerTV was checking this one. Send it again to use it.

configure.title: Settings for {{name}}
configure.lead: Open the addon's settings page on your phone, choose what you want, and send the install link it gives you to BannerTV. The new settings then replace the old ones here.
configure.scan: Scan with your phone's camera: the QR code also opens the addon's settings. If you already have the new install link, go to this address and enter the code:
configure.tooLong: This addon's settings address is too long for a QR code, so open its settings on your phone yourself. Then scan, or go to this address and enter the code, to send the new install link:
configure.received: New settings for {{name}} arrived. Press Update to use them.

installError.invalid-url: That doesn't look like an addon address. It starts with https:// and usually ends in manifest.json.
installError.unreachable: BannerTV couldn't reach that address. Check it, and that the TV is online.
installError.not-an-addon: That address answered, but not with an addon.
installError.different-addon: That link is for a different addon. Add it with Add an addon instead.

addonError.network: {{addon}} could not be reached. Check the TV is online.
addonError.notFound: None of your addons know this title.

details.noEpisodes: This addon lists no episodes yet.
details.trailerFailed: The YouTube app didn't open. Check it's installed on the TV.

sleep.title: Sleep timer
sleep.endOfEpisodeNote: Pauses when this episode ends, instead of playing the next one.

speed.title: Speed
speed.note: Speeds this TV passed in the Lab for this kind of stream. The next stream starts at Normal.
speed.notPassed: The Lab has passed no other speed for {{kind}} on this TV.
speed.notTested: Other speeds aren't tested for this kind of stream.

test.ready: Measures 0.75×, 1.25× and 1.5× for {{kind}}, and asks if you hear sound at each. Stay on this tab until it ends.
test.listening: Playing at {{rate}}. Can you hear the sound, at the right pitch?
test.unsteady: Couldn't measure: the video stopped or stuttered. Nothing was saved. Try again.
test.notSaved: Nothing settled, so nothing was saved.

stillWatching.title: Still watching?
stillWatching.message: The next episode of {{title}} is ready.

player.tryingAnother: That stream stopped, so BannerTV is trying another.
player.steppingDown: That stream kept stopping to load, so BannerTV is switching to a lighter one.
player.keepsBuffering: This stream keeps stopping to load. Quality has a lighter one.
player.keepsBufferingStreams: This stream keeps stopping to load. Sources has smaller ones.
player.keepsBufferingPlain: This stream keeps stopping to load.
player.pickLanguage: Pick a language on the left.
player.noAudioChoice: This stream has no other audio to choose from.
player.timingNone: Subtitles as the file has them
player.timingOff: Turn subtitles on to change their timing.
player.sampleLine: This is how subtitles will look.

problem.nothing: None of your addons offered a stream this TV can play. Try All streams, or add a stream addon in Addons.
problem.format: This TV can't play this stream's format.
problem.network: The stream stopped loading. Its source may be busy or offline.
problem.decode: The TV couldn't decode this stream.
problem.clip: This stream is only a short clip, not the video. Its source may not have it ready yet.
problem.other: Something went wrong playing this stream.

streams.title: All streams
streams.none: No addon offered a stream for this.
streams.heavy: A very large file: it may keep stopping to load on this TV's connection.

cannot.torrent: A torrent. Torrents need a streaming engine, which comes in a later update.
cannot.proxy-headers: Needs request headers the TV's player can't send. Pair a stream helper in Settings to play it.
cannot.external: Opens a web page, which BannerTV can't show.

warnings.truehd: Dolby TrueHD sound: this TV may play it silently.
warnings.dts: DTS sound: this TV can't decode it, so there may be no sound.
warnings.av1: AV1 video: this TV can't decode it.
warnings.hevc: HEVC video: this TV can't decode it.
warnings.dolby-vision-as-hdr10: Dolby Vision: plays as HDR10 on this TV.
warnings.dolby-vision-only: Dolby Vision only: colours may look wrong on this TV.
warnings.uhd-on-hd-tv: 4K: more than this TV can show, and slow to start.
warnings.hdr-on-sdr-tv: HDR: colours may look dull on this TV.
warnings.old-container: An old file type: it may not start, and seeking may be slow.
warnings.cam: Recorded in a cinema: poor picture and sound.
warnings.uncached: Not cached by your debrid service yet: it would have to download first.

settings.kidsLead: How subtitles look. Grown-ups can change the rest from their own profile.
settings.tmdbCredit: Extra details and images from TMDB. BannerTV uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

lab.noAudioTracksApi: audioTracks is not exposed by this engine

startClock.playing: Clock at start: {{playing}} at the playing event
startClock.both: Clock at start: {{playing}} at the playing event, {{update}} at the first timeupdate ({{delay}} ms later)

welcome.title: Welcome to BannerTV
welcome.lead: Films and series from the addons you choose, in one place and made for your remote.
welcome.ready: Cinemeta and BannerTV Demo are already added, so Home is ready to browse, with a few free films to play. You can add more addons at any time in Addons, by typing an address or sending it from your phone.
welcome.notice: Apart from BannerTV Demo, a few Creative Commons films from the Blender Foundation for trying the app, BannerTV doesn't host or provide any films or series. Everything else comes from the addons you add, and you're responsible for the addons you choose.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.lead: Everyone gets their own Continue Watching, My List, history and settings. A kids profile only shows family films and series.
profiles.manageHint: Add or change profiles in Settings.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.full: This TV already has six profiles.
profiles.kidsExplained: Only family films and series, no Addons, and limited Settings. Ratings come from TMDB when it is on, and titles without one are left out.
profiles.mainNotKids: Main set BannerTV up, so it is never a kids profile.
profiles.youNotKids: Switch to another profile to make this one a kids profile.
profiles.askAtLaunch: Ask who's watching when BannerTV opens: {{value}}
profiles.deleteMessage: Their Continue Watching, My List, history and settings are deleted from this TV. Anything synced to Trakt stays on Trakt.

pin.mismatch: Those PINs didn't match. Choose one again.

homeRows.title: Home rows
homeRows.lead: Put the rows you watch most at the top, and hide the ones you never use. Only this profile changes.
homeRows.none: There are no rows yet. Add an addon with catalogs first.

library.emptyList: Nothing saved yet. Press My List on a title to keep it here.
library.emptyHistory: Nothing played yet. What you watch shows up here.

kids.notForKids: This title isn't available in a kids profile.

trakt.title: Trakt
trakt.lead: Trakt keeps where you stopped, what you've watched and My List the same on every app you use with it.
trakt.goTo: On your phone or computer, go to {{url}} and enter
trakt.codeLasts_one: The code works for 1 more minute.
trakt.codeLasts_other: The code works for {{count}} more minutes.
trakt.codeExpired: That code ran out before it was entered. Get a new one to try again.
trakt.denied: The sign-in was turned down on Trakt.

failed.network: BannerTV couldn't reach Trakt. Check the TV's connection and try again.
failed.unavailable: Trakt isn't set up on BannerTV's service yet.
failed.signedOut: Trakt didn't accept the sign-in. Try again.
failed.other: Trakt couldn't sign you in. Try again.

trakt.signInExpired: Your Trakt sign-in ran out. Sign in again to keep syncing.
trakt.syncFailed: The last sync didn't finish. BannerTV tries again in half an hour.
trakt.signOutMessage: BannerTV stops syncing with Trakt on this profile. My List and where you stopped stay on this TV.

streamHelper.title: Stream helper
streamHelper.leadTv: Some add-on streams need extra request headers that this TV's player can't send. BannerTV on an Android phone or TV box on the same Wi-Fi can fetch them for the TV. Turn the helper on there, then type its address and code here.
streamHelper.leadAndroid: Some add-on streams need extra request headers that an LG TV's player can't send. While the helper is on, your LG can play them through this device. The video stays on your home Wi-Fi.
streamHelper.onNote: On. Keep this device on the same Wi-Fi as the TV while you watch.
streamHelper.typeOnTv: On your LG, open Settings > Stream helper and type:
streamHelper.noWifi: Connect this device to the same Wi-Fi as your TV to see its address.
streamHelper.updateApp: Update BannerTV on this device to use the stream helper.
streamHelper.addressPlaceholder: Shown on the helper, for example 192.168.1.42
streamHelper.codePlaceholder: Six digits shown on the helper
streamHelper.reachable: The helper is on. Streams that need it will play.
streamHelper.unreachable: Can't reach the helper. Open BannerTV on your phone or box, turn the helper on, and keep it on the same Wi-Fi.

failed.bad-address: Type the address as the helper shows it, for example 192.168.1.42.
failed.wrong-code: That code didn't match. Check the code on the helper and try again.
failed.unreachable: Can't reach the helper at that address. Check it's on and on the same Wi-Fi.
